changeinfo.changes: Patch includes voiceover data for French, and German.

BIG CHANGES/UPDATES/NEW FEATURES
- Fixed VOIP related issues so system is now functional * Voice chat has been optimized significantly, allowing for players to easily join, leave and manage channels. User interface for VOIP has also been updated considerable to be more consistent
- Modify instances of UserID or Character Name so they displayed Online IDs * Group user interface display is more robust and works with console Online IDs
- Settings are now saved when you exist the menu * User interface Options and Settings should persist after selection, and many other fixes improve the functionality of these settings
- Better social feature integration
- Crash fixes
FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS
- General * Logging into and out of the game is now much more robust * "PSN" functionality has been significantly improved, allowing for online ID integration, safeguards with installation, input verification and stability checks, and various crash fixes
- Audio * Added audio support and improved audio performance for a large number of screens * Fixed an issue where audio would dropout on occasion
- Performance * Performance improvements for particle effect and animation * Intro cinematic should play smoothly * Many memory leaks and frame spiking issues were fixed across the board * Various quest and dungeon updates that improve performance and reduce overall lag
- Social * Guild communication channels should be more efficient and user-friendly * Guild management tools are more stable and provide more functionality
- Tutorial * Fixed a number of tutorial bugs where the tutorials were not firing * Added additional text based tutorials
- User Interface * Localization improvements for German and French in many user interface screens * Fixed some Achievements and Trophy user interface truncation issues * Improvements on group finder user interface * Many error codes and messages are now more user-friendly * Legal agreements are now easier to navigate and read * Alliance War user interface screens are easier to navigate and show more information * Interactive windows with NPCs and books have a unified user interface scheme * Fixed many crash issues and user interface lockout problems in Character Creation * Fixed many Crafting user interface errors and improved the way crafting is displayed * Refined the entire gamepad menu transitioning experience to be smoother and more reliable * Numerous Ability, Synergy, Champion point and Skill interface updates * Safeguards added to prevent players from locking themselves in user interface with accidental spamming * Fixed many user interface errors involving inventory management, trading and vendors
